item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find evidence of a single, across-the-board mobility breakthrough. The strongest case is instead cumulative: stronger labor markets, lower inflation, cheaper health and education access, and place-based investment improved chances for many people, especially lower-income and disadvantaged groups. The main limits are persistent housing costs, mixed attribution for macro gains, and serious negative cases in protest policing and Gaza accountability.","evidence":[{"title":"Joint Statement of Janet L. Yellen and Shalanda D. Young on Budget Results for FY 2024","publisher":"U.S. Department of the Treasury","date":"2024-10-18","url":"https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy2657","summary":"Says the administration had created 16+ million jobs, kept unemployment near historic lows, lifted real worker incomes, and was pushing down housing, child care, health, and drug costs. This is a direct attempt to improve opportunity, not just aggregate welfare.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.8"]},{"title":"The Better FAFSA: What Students and Their Families Need to Know","publisher":"U.S. Department of Education","date":"2024-02-16","url":"https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/paying-college/better-fafsa-what-students-and-their-families-need-know","summary":"Simplifies aid access and expands Pell eligibility, which broadens educational opportunity for lower-income students and families.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.8","6B.9"]},{"title":"Negotiating Lower Drug Prices Works, Saves Billions","publisher":"CMS","date":"2024-08-15","url":"https://www.cms.gov/newsroom/press-releases/negotiating-lower-drug-prices-works-saves-billions","summary":"Lower out-of-pocket drug costs for millions of Medicare beneficiaries, improving access to care and disposable income.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.8","6B.9"]},{"title":"Tech Hubs funding round","publisher":"U.S. Department of Commerce","date":"2024-07-02","url":"https://www.commerce.gov/news/press-releases/2024/07/biden-harris-administration-announces-next-funding-round-504-million-12","summary":"Uses competitive grants to send opportunity to rural, Tribal, industrial, and disadvantaged communities, which is a life-chances policy aimed at places that are often left behind.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.7","6B.8","6B.9"]},{"title":"Life-saving and life-sustaining disaster response efforts","publisher":"The American Presidency Project / White House","date":"2024-09-27","url":"https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/fact-sheet-biden-harris-administrations-life-saving-and-life-sustaining-response-efforts","summary":"Prioritizes FEMA deployment, temporary housing, food, water, and recovery support for disaster survivors. That directly improves life chances for affected households.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.6"]},{"title":"Industrial investment disproportionately favors poorer counties","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-02-13","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/us-factory-boom-disproportionately-favors-poorer-counties-study-shows-3302493","summary":"Reuters reported Biden-era industrial investment flowed disproportionately to poorer counties rather than Democratic geography, which cuts against a narrow patronage story and supports broader opportunity creation.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.7","6B.8"]},{"title":"Biden seeks to cancel some interest on student loans, aiding 23 million Americans","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-04-08","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/biden-seeks-to-cancel-some-interest-on-student-loans-aiding-23-million-americans-3368853","summary":"Real affordability gains existed, but Reuters said the White House framed the plan around winning young voters. That makes the life-chances benefit real but partly tactical.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.7","6B.8"]},{"title":"Critics said Biden’s student-loan relief skewed toward college borrowers and higher-income recipients","publisher":"Associated Press","date":"2024-02-26","url":"https://apnews.com/article/8a751e085839df0b19c0a599169002cf","summary":"Critics argued the relief shifted costs onto nonborrowers and was not broadly calibrated, which weakens a clean “ordinary people improved” claim.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.7","6B.8"]},{"title":"Police were advised to avoid mass arrests, then came the US campus protests","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-05-10","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/police-were-advised-to-avoid-mass-arrests-then-came-the-us-campus-protests-3433913","summary":"Mass arrests across campuses despite advice to avoid that approach suggest a coercive climate that likely chilled student life chances and equal participation.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.8","4B.6"]},{"title":"US tracking nearly 500 incidents of civilian harm during Israel's Gaza war","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-10-30","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/us-tracking-nearly-500-incidents-of-civilian-harm-during-gaza-war-3691690","summary":"Reuters reported nearly 500 potential civilian-harm incidents involving U.S.-furnished weapons, with no further action taken on any of them, which weakens a broad claim that Biden improved ordinary civilians’ life chances in conflict settings.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.6","6B.8"]},{"title":"US IMF Article IV concluding statement","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-06-27","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/06/27/cs62724-united-states-concluding-statement-of-the-2024-article-iv","summary":"IMF said activity and employment exceeded expectations and disinflation was less costly than feared, but warned deficits, debt, and trade/subsidy distortions remained significant risks. That supports a better-than-inherited baseline, but not an unqualified life-chances breakthrough.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.2"]}]}
